definition: agitated, disturbed or troubled greatly; perturbed.
example_en: On hearing the news, people's minds became greatly agitated.

definition: the quality of being curious.
example: ಮಗುವಿಗೆ ಹೊಸ ಆಟಿಕೆಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಕವುತುಕ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: The child had curiosity about the new toy.

definition: to take a drink or liquid food, in gulps, through the gullet into the stomach.
example_en: He gulped down the water quickly.

definition: to stir, agitate a liquid (in a container) (as with a ladle).
example_en: She stirred the soup with a ladle.

definition: a deformed, bent hand.
example_en: He had a deformed, bent hand from birth.

definition: to cause uproar, hub-hub.
example_en: Everyone caused an uproar over a small matter.

definition: the act or an instance of putting another in deep trouble; harassment.
example_en: The creditors' harassment distressed him greatly.

definition: a chequered or colourful carpet.
example_en: They had spread a colourful carpet in the wedding pavilion.

definition: the tree Madhuca indica ( = Bassia latifolia) of Sapotaceae family; Indian butter tree; (?).
example_en: Indian butter trees are abundant in the forest.

definition: a shaft with a sharp point at one end.
example_en: He planted the pointed shaft into the ground.

definition: the falling or loss of, a part of the body.
example_en: He suffered the loss of a limb in the accident.
